summary: Published 4-bit checkpoints (GPTQ, AWQ, compressed-tensors int4 groups, MXFP4) run as stored with BF16 activations: exact conversion to one canonical layout, a 4-bit decode GEMV for up to 8 tokens with per-token reduction order, and a BF16 tensor-core prompt GEMM
implementation_scope: CUDA converters from GPTQ (act-order permutation by a stable counting sort, v1 and v2 zero conventions), AWQ (its column interleave) and compressed-tensors pack-quantized (symmetric or explicit zero points) to canonical codes, FP32 scales and uint8 zeros; MXFP4 blocks and E8M0 scales used as stored; a warp-per-row GEMV dequantizing in FP32 registers; a 64 x 64 tile GEMM dequantizing to BF16 in shared memory for mma.m16n8k16 on sm_80+; an activation gather for act-order. A Python reference of every format's unpacking. Model integration and fusion are engine supplied.

agent_guidance.use_when: Weights must run as published and are GPTQ, AWQ, compressed-tensors int4 or MXFP4, or the GPU has no FP4 tensor cores (sm_80 to sm_89)
agent_guidance.avoid_when: The checkpoint is NVFP4 on sm_120 (stored-tile-gemm runs it on FP4 tensor cores), activations should be quantized too (W4A4, W8A8), or a measured Marlin-class provider from Kernels is already integrated
provides: Exact conversion of GPTQ (act-order, both zero conventions), AWQ and compressed-tensors int4 to one canonical layout
MXFP4 (gpt-oss) codes and E8M0 exponents read as stored
A decode GEMV for 1 to 8 tokens whose per-token result does not depend on the token count
A BF16 tensor-core prompt GEMM over the same canonical weights
engine_supplies: The checkpoint tensors on the device for conversion and the canonical buffers
The act-order gather into a scratch activation row and output fusion
The GEMV or GEMM choice by token count, and non-quantized layers in their own format
preserve: Every format's exact bit layout, zero convention and act-order permutation
The GEMV's per-token reduction order for verify columns
adapt: Marlin-style pipelining and fragment-order weights pre-shuffled at load
Split-K for small grids, FP16 activations, FP16 scales
Fusing the act-order gather into the producing layer

code_files.purpose: Canonical weights, GEMV, GEMM, gather and converter interfaces
CUDA converters, the 4-bit GEMV and the BF16 tensor-core GEMM
Host reference: each format's unpacking, the canonical layout and the projection

requires.hardware: CUDA C++20 on sm_80 or later (BF16 mma.sync and ldmatrix); Python 3.11+ for the reference
requires.model: Linear layers quantized as GPTQ, AWQ or compressed-tensors int4 (groups of 32, 64 or 128) or MXFP4; K a multiple of 64, GEMM N a multiple of 64
requires.workload: Decode, speculative verify and prefill with BF16 activations

contract.input: Checkpoint tensors (qweight, qzeros, scales, g_idx; or packed, scale, zero point; or MXFP4 blocks and scales), BF16 activations [T][K] with a stride, FP32 outputs [T][N]
contract.output: Canonical codes, scales, zeros and act-order permutation; FP32 products, optionally added to the output
contract.ownership: The engine owns every buffer; kernels borrow them on the caller's stream
contract.failure: Unsupported group sizes, K not a multiple of 64, GEMM N not a multiple of 64, more than 8 GEMV tokens, misaligned strides and null buffers are rejected at launch; act-order g_idx must give every group `group` columns
contract.core_boundary: None beyond Core's resources for the buffers; the engine's model owns the layers

validation.host: GPTQ (act-order and the v1 zero offset), AWQ and compressed-tensors packings of one matrix unpack to the same represented weights; the act-order projection equals the original; MXFP4 values
validation.native: GPTQ (act-order, both zero conventions), AWQ and compressed-tensors convert to the canonical bytes, scales, zeros and permutation a host packer writes; GEMV for 1 to 8 tokens and GEMM against FP64 products for groups of 32, 64 and 128 and for MXFP4; a token alone equal to the same token in a batch; rejections
validation.performance: No speed claim; reference GEMV and an unpipelined tile GEMM
